# Number of Valid Words in a Sentence.

@example The chunks are "buy", "2", "eggs,", "milk-tea", "and" and "jam."; all but "2", which holds a digit, are valid words. The extra spaces only separate chunks.
"  buy 2 eggs,  milk-tea and jam. "
=> 5

@example Only "re-do" is valid. The other hyphens stand at the start or the end of a chunk, come twice, or have the mark right after them.
"re-do -it it- a-b-c x-."
=> 1

@example "." and "!" are valid; "stop!." has two marks, ",go" has its mark first, and "r2d2" has digits.
"stop!. ,go . r2d2 !"
=> 2

# A single one-letter chunk.
"a"
=> 1

# A lone hyphen is not a valid word; a lone mark of each kind is.
"- . ! ,"
=> 3

# A hyphen at the start, at the end, and just before the mark; then a
# hyphen between letters, followed by a mark, which is fine.
"-ox ox- ox-. ox-en."
=> 1

# Two hyphens, apart or side by side, each with a letter beside it.
"a-b-c a--b"
=> 0

# Marks in the wrong place: first, in the middle, two at the end, before a
# hyphen.
".up up.on hey!! hi,. go,-on"
=> 0

# A digit anywhere spoils a chunk, even one of an otherwise valid shape.
"1ab a1b ab1 a-1b a1-b ab-c5d. 7 0."
=> 0

# Whether one chunk is valid says nothing about the next.
"a1 b c-d e-f-g h"
=> 3

# The last chunk, with no space after it, counts like any other.
"go now"
=> 2

"go n0w"
=> 1

# Spaces at both ends of a single chunk.
"   x   "
=> 1

# One chunk of 1000 characters.
"-!"
=> 1

# 500 one-character chunks, all valid: a count kept in a byte would wrap.
"a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ! . , a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ! . , a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ! . , a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ! . , a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ! . , a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ! . , a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ! . , a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ! . , a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ! . , a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ! . , a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ! . , a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ! . , a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ! . , a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ! . , a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ! . , a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ! . , a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ! . , a b c d e f g"
=> 500

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 1 small
".1   !-b! aa-a  "
=> 1

@gen 2 small
" a-a  a.!a  , ! b-.!"
=> 3

@gen 3 small
"b-ba ! ,b  -b- ..,  a-a"
=> 3

@gen 4 small
"b ,bb"
=> 1

@gen 5 small
"! a- ab!  -.b"
=> 2

@gen 6 small
"a! b! !  -a "
=> 3

@gen 7 small
"a 1-a . b-b"
=> 3
